outcome: human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels at diagnosis
cohort: The study included all cases of cervical pregnancy (10) and cesarean scar pregnancy (32) diagnosed and treated in a tertiary gynecology department between 2014 and 2022, identified from 899 ectopic pregnancies.
finding: Although cervical pregnancy and cesarean scar pregnancy exhibit differences in certain clinical and demographic characteristics, similar treatment approaches, particularly initial methotrexate followed by D&E, appear feasible.
gest_age: Patients in both groups presented at similar gestational ages (not specified for babies, but for pregnancy diagnosis).
